title: Solve a Quadratic Assignment Problem — qap
text: Given flows facilities distances locations B, QAP seeks assignment minimizes sum flow times distance. assignment represented permutation matrix \(X\), objective $$\min_{X \\Pi}\; \mathrm{tr}(AXBX^T)$$ QAP originated facility location problem (Koopmans Beckmann, 1957) also applications data analysis (Hubert Schultz, 1976). NP-hard. solver uses simulated annealing heuristic Burkard Rendl (1984), based Rendl's Fortran implementation QAPLIB. authors suggest can produce heuristic solutions problems 256 objects, although implementation enforce limit. Additional solver arguments : rep Number restarts; default 1L. miter Number iterations fixed temperature; default 2 * nrow(). fiter Factor miter grows cooling step; default 1.1. ft Factor temperature decreases cooling step; default 0.5 (0 1). maxsteps Maximum number cooling steps; default 50L. verbose Print progress; default FALSE.
